title: Cyberwave Twin Flight Controller State
description: The autopilot's slowly-changing state as an aircraft driver decodes it: armed, flight mode, failsafe, pre-arm verdict, recent status texts, and optionally the link, mission progress and home position. Published on {prefix}cyberwave/twin/{twin_uuid}/flight_controller whenever it changes, plus a slow refresh, so a stored history is a mode-transition history. Identified by its topic, not by a field: the payload carries no contract id. Fields a single driver adds beyond these (PX4's params, a control level) ride along under the open root and are not part of this contract.

source_type.description: Runtime that produced the state: edge for a real autopilot, sim for a simulated one (SITL). Same vocabulary as source_type.envelope.v1.

timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds at which the driver sampled the state.

session_id.description: Driver session the state belongs to, when the driver runs inside one; absent or null outside one.

autopilot.description: Autopilot firmware family, e.g. ardupilot or px4. Absent when the driver serves one firmware and does not say which.

vehicle.description: Airframe class the firmware flies, e.g. plane, copter or vtol.

armed.description: Whether the autopilot reports its motors armed (MAV_MODE_FLAG_SAFETY_ARMED).

mode.description: Decoded flight mode name as the firmware's own ground station shows it, e.g. AUTO.LOITER on PX4 or RTL on ArduPilot. For display; its spelling is the firmware's, so readers must not parse it. An undecodable mode is reported as UNKNOWN(<custom_mode>).

custom_mode.description: The raw HEARTBEAT custom_mode the mode name was decoded from. Firmware-specific; meaningful only together with autopilot.

system_status.description: The raw HEARTBEAT system_status (MAV_STATE): 3 standby, 4 active, 5 critical, 6 emergency, 8 flight termination.

failsafe.description: Whether the autopilot is in a failsafe, as the driver derives it for its firmware.

ready_to_arm.description: The autopilot's pre-arm verdict. null or absent when the autopilot does not report one; false also while the driver itself blocks arming.

status_texts.description: The most recent STATUSTEXT messages the autopilot sent, oldest first, as evidence for the state (e.g. why pre-arm fails).

text.description: The message text, without trailing NUL padding.

severity.description: MAV_SEVERITY: 0 emergency ... 3 error, 4 warning ... 6 info, 7 debug.

link.description: The driver's MAVLink link to the autopilot. Present for drivers that keep running, and keep publishing this state, while the aircraft is unreachable.

connected.description: Whether a HEARTBEAT arrived within the driver's link timeout. When false every other field is the last known value.

vehicle_sysid.description: MAVLink system id of the vehicle the driver follows; null before the first HEARTBEAT.

transmit_enabled.description: Whether the driver may transmit to the autopilot; false on a listen-only link.

reboots.description: Autopilot reboots the driver has observed since it started.

mission.description: Progress through the mission loaded on the autopilot, as the autopilot numbers its items.

current_seq.description: Sequence number of the item the autopilot is executing (MISSION_CURRENT.seq).

total.description: Number of items in the loaded mission, when the autopilot reports it.

last_reached_seq.description: Sequence number of the last item the autopilot reported reached (MISSION_ITEM_REACHED).

home.description: The home position the autopilot returns to (HOME_POSITION).

altitude.description: Altitude in metres above mean sea level.
